obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional source relation; candidate inner complement bound or ambiguous converse
obernants.assumptions: Domain: finite valid byte files, bounded IDs and successful allocation; an operation's arguments plus its initial filesystem and scheduler state are inputs. Observations include returns/errors and written bytes. No simultaneous writer, path traversal, malformed offsets or crash is assumed unless explicitly modeled. Source-derived conditional relation, not a proof of all Rust executions. Evidence: tests.md distinguishes executed probes from proposed oracles.
obernants.domain: Finite admitted calls and filesystem states; exact specialization in catalog
obernants.observation_scope: One call or finite publication trace
obernants.operator: U is valid metadata and size x block list. U minus R contains a positive block crossing a book boundary or splitting a paragraph solely because size was reached. Candidate inner bound: book boundary always cuts; size only cuts at paragraph end. Probe explicit paragraph fixture.

obernants.operator: For observed block spans, every metadata sequence whose internal positions avoid the cut predicate and whose block ends satisfy book_end or(size reached and para_end) is a preimage. Book and paragraph numeric labels are not uniquely recovered. Oracle: relabeling preserves blocks.

obernants.operator: For n>0, blocks partitions [0,n) into contiguous positive intervals; total length n. Fisher-Yates permutes these intervals, so expanded valid order covers each ID once. n=0 gives no blocks. Probe sizes 0,1,2,400 checks sum, contiguity and expansion.

obernants.operator: Prefix wants ceil(n*pct/100) but emits whole blocks: for 0<want<=n, want<=out_len< want+last_block_len; want>n emits n. pct<=0 casts to zero; NaN also becomes zero; infinity may cause capacity failure and is outside admitted probe domain. Probe bounded percentages and overshoot.
